title: First hearing When the Saints Go Marching In
summary: Bailey says he first heard the song only when Louis Armstrong recorded it.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line

blocks.x: When did you first hear when the Saints go marching in? Did they ever sing that years ago?

No, no. Well I heard it when Louis Armstrong came on the record. Yeah. That's when Louis Armstrong come on the record. They go marching in. You never heard the band play at them before? No, not before Louis Armstrong. Sure didn't. And you didn't hear it in the church? No. Well they used to sing. Used to sing, but I know music. They used to sing. I know music.
